tags.name: 1893 Chicago Harbor Lighthouse
tags.note: On June 12, 1917, Congress appropriated $88,000 for relocating Chicago Harbor Lighthouse. The existing breakwater had been extended southward, and a second breakwater was being constructed south of it.
